description: The 'dss_codeenvs_live' dataset provides detailed information about live code environments within the Dataiku platform. This dataset is crucial for managing and understanding the various configurations and deployments of code environments used in data projects. Each entry in the dataset represents a specific code environment, detailing its name, language, deployment mode, and owner. Additionally, it includes technical specifications such as the Python interpreter version and core package set used. The dataset also provides the file path to the environment and a list of its usages, which can be critical for tracking dependencies and project associations. Furthermore, each environment is linked to a URL for easy access and management within the Dataiku interface. This dataset is particularly useful for administrators and data engineers who need to monitor and optimize the use of computational resources, ensure compliance with software standards, and facilitate collaboration across different teams. By analyzing this dataset, users can gain insights into the operational aspects of their data science workflows and make informed decisions about environment management.
shortDesc: Dataset of live code environments in Dataiku, detailing configurations and usage.

columns.name: envName
columns.comment: Name of the code environment, identifies environment.

columns.name: deploymentMode
columns.comment: Mode of deployment, indicates management type.

columns.name: pythonInterpreter
columns.comment: Python version used, specifies interpreter version.

columns.name: corePackagesSet
columns.comment: Core packages configuration, defines package set.

columns.name: path
columns.comment: File path to environment, locates environment files.

columns.name: usages
columns.comment: List of projects using the environment, tracks usage.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL to access environment, provides management link.
